camel_example: aliyun csas CreatePrivateAccessApplication --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --Protocol All --Name private_access_application_name
description_en: Creates a private access application within the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 创建当前阿里云账号下内网访问应用
kebab_example: aliyun csas create-private-access-application --name private_access_application_name --protocol All --status Enabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePrivateAccessApplication

parameters.help_en: The name of the private access application. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: 这是一条内网访问应用
parameters.help_en: The description of the private access application. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The collection of private access application addresses. You can enter up to 1,000 private access application addresses
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用地址集合。最多可输入1000个内网访问应用地址
parameters.name: addresses

fields.help_en: The start port. The value must be less than or equal to the end port
fields.help_zh: 起始端口。小于等于结束端口
fields.name: begin

fields.help_en: The end port. The value must be greater than or equal to the start port
fields.help_zh: 结束端口。大于等于起始端口
fields.name: end

parameters.help_en: The collection of port ranges for the private access application. You can enter up to 65,535 port ranges. Multiple port ranges cannot be duplicate or overlap
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问应用端口范围集合。最多可输入65535个端口范围。多个端口范围不可重复或重叠
parameters.name: port_ranges

parameters.help_en:
The protocol of the private access application. Valid values:
All: All protocols.
TCP
UDP
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问应用协议。取值：
All：全部。
TCP
UDP
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The status of the private access application. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问应用状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The collection of private access tag IDs. You can associate up to six custom private access tags with a single private access application
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问标签ID集合。1个内网访问应用最多可关联6个自定义类型的内网访问标签
parameters.name: tag_ids

parameters.help_en:
The browser access status of the private access application. After you enable this feature, you can access private access applications without a client. Default value: Disabled. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled

内网访问应用状态，开启后可以通过无端方式访问内网应用。默认值为Disabled。取值：

parameters.help_en:
The health check mode. Valid values:
OnAccess: Checks upon access without proactive probing.
Continuous: Performs continuous checks and proactive probing based on the configurations in HealthCheckConfig.
If this parameter is not specified, the default value is OnAccess. When the application addresses include wildcard domain names or CIDR blocks, or when the number of application addresses exceeds 10, only OnAccess is supported
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查模式，取值：
OnAccess：按访问检查，不主动探测。
Continuous：持续检查，按 HealthCheckConfig 中的配置周期性探测。
未填写时默认为 OnAccess。当应用地址包含泛域名、CIDR，或应用地址数量超过 10 个时，仅支持 OnAccess
parameters.name: health_check_mode

fields.help_en: The check interval in seconds. Default value: 30 seconds
fields.help_zh: 检查频率（秒），默认30秒
fields.name: check_interval

fields.help_en: The failure count. Default value: 3
fields.help_zh: 失败次数，默认3次
fields.name: failure_count

fields.help_en: The port number. This parameter is optional
fields.help_zh: 端口号，可选
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The protocol type. Valid values: TCP and UDP. This parameter is required only in Continuous mode
fields.help_zh: 协议类型，TCP或UDP，仅在Continuous模式下需要
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The timeout period for a single check in seconds. Default value: 5 seconds
fields.help_zh: 单次检查超时时间（秒），默认5秒
fields.name: timeout_seconds

parameters.help_en: The health check configuration. This parameter is required when HealthCheckMode is set to Continuous, and cannot be specified when HealthCheckMode is set to OnAccess
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查配置。当 HealthCheckMode 为 Continuous 时必填；当 HealthCheckMode 为 OnAccess 时不可填写
parameters.name: health_check_config

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_zh:
